sources.title: Visa for Turkmenistan
sources.officialityEvidence: Turkmenistan's official embassy in Bucharest says its stated information concerns Romanian citizens and sets out the pre-travel embassy visa process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For to obtain a visa at the Embassy need to submit the following documents.

policies.title: Romanian ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Romanian ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Turkmenistan's standard visitor visa through its Bucharest embassy before travel.
conditions: The official Romanian-accredited embassy requires an invitation, passport, application forms and photographs for its normal mission-issued visa process.
The airport tourist route also requires an invitation issued by the State Migration Service and is excluded as a conditional route.
This excludes work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission.
